queries.sql: SELECT l.id, l.name as location_name, l.type, COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) as total_items FROM locations l LEFT JOIN stocks s ON l.id = s.location_id GROUP BY l.id

SELECT p.sku, p.name as product_name, p.min_stock, s.qty as current_qty, l.name as location_name FROM stocks s JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.id JOIN locations l ON s.location_id = l.id WHERE s.qty <= p.min_stock ORDER BY s.qty ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_tx, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as total_revenue FROM sales WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
SELECT s.invoice_number, s.total_amount, s.created_at, l.name as location_name FROM sales s JOIN locations l ON s.location_id = l.id ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT p.name, p.sku, SUM(si.qty) as total_sold, p.unit FROM sale_items si JOIN products p ON si.product_id = p.id GROUP BY si.product_id ORDER BY total_sold DESC LIMIT 5
